summary: Cut at 6.4 (round 1: 5.6, round 2: 6.2, Caiman: 7, ship bar: 7.5). This is round 3 and the score is below 7.5, so the rule is cut. Every gate is now green and checks out against report.json, draft-gates.json and verification.json. The round-2 wall-gate gap is closed: 66 ray_walls entries cover every metal made part, each with at least 203 rays. The worst hard-edge skip is 292, no part reads below its floor, and the gate line and lost_wax_note now name the true classes. The art did not move enough. (1) The leaflets are still inflated pillows with crimped, stair-stepped margins (leaf-close.png, face.png). A crease midvein was added, but the blades are not flat or bevelled, and the teeth do not read as forward-hooked serrations. In face-300 the spray still reads as laurel or olive more than rose. (2) The hip dome is now worse: it shows stepped concentric tessellation bands and a sharp apex star (stones.png, face.png, leaf-close.png). The setting is still a plain round-lipped collar with a flat inner land, and reads as a solitaire. (3) The calyx shows from the face as asked, but one sepal stands straight up over the girdle like a single claw, and with the curved sepals either side it reads as a prong cradle, not a rose's sepal crown. (4) The ground is still two smooth twisted wires. There is no bark. There are 7 nodes against the 8 asked for, and they show only as small knobs. Under the palm in hero.png there is still an evenly spaced row of 7 or 8 same-facing prickles, the centipede comb round 2 flagged. Leaf 2 is leaf 1 turned round the hip, not the scaled and folded variant asked for, so the face view is mirror-symmetric. Gains: the side shoots now end in tapered buds instead of sawn discs, the weight is up to 7.30 g, and the plant read (pinnate leaves, prickled canes, orange hip) holds at 300 px. Next to caiman/hero.png and the Reptilia sheet the ornament covers well under half of the visible surface, and the modelling is below their finish. Three rounds are used.
strengths: Every gate green and fully recorded: 66 ray_walls entries (every metal made part), minimum 203 rays, maximum hard-edge skip 292, 0 parts below floor; bodies, leaflets and sepal bodies at 0.8 mm (leaflets 0.85-0.91, receptacle 0.85, sepals 0.83), points at 0.15 mm (prickles 0.25-0.41).
The plant read holds at 300 px: pinnate leaves, a prickled twin cane and an opaque orange oval hip say wild rose more than any other plant.
Side shoots now end in tapered live buds, not flat sawn tubes (hero.png left, palm.png right, reverse.png lower right).
Sepal tips now show in the face view at the hip's proximal end, and the five-sepal star reads well from the side (side.png).
The silhouette is unique in Vepres: an open crossed twin-cane with an off-axis spray and a raised oval hip.
The hip stone is correct in spec: oval cabochon 6.4 x 4.8, transmission 0.05, tint [0.72, 0.20, 0.06], and stones.json agrees with report.json.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: Rose cane, prickles, nodes with stipules, bud-tipped shoots, leaves, hip and calyx only, thinning to cane and prickles at the palm.

checklist.item: Reads as its plant at 300 px without the caption
checklist.reason: Marginal pass. In hero-300 the prickled canes, the pinnate sprays and the orange oval hip together say rose or briar. In face-300 alone the puffy crimped leaflets still read as a laurel or olive wreath round a carnelian, so the read depends on the canes.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, crisp, no combing, smearing or stair-steps
checklist.reason: Leaflet margins are still ragged and stair-stepped, with crimped bulges, not hooked serrations (leaf-close.png, every leaflet; face.png). The midvein is a pinched crease on a pillow. The hip dome shows stepped tessellation bands and an apex star, worse than round 2 (stones.png, face.png). Round-2 punch 2 and the tessellation part of punch 3 are not met.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, visible, coloured as the plant's fruit
checklist.reason: One opaque orange-red oval hip in a made bezel, fully visible and the right colour. The setting's form and the dome faceting are judged under the CAD and outline items.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: The bezel is still a uniform round-lipped collar with a flat inner land, not a flared receptacle cup, and the hip reads as a solitaire (stones.png, face.png). The leaflets are uniform inflated blobs. The canes are constant-section smooth tubes with no bark or swelling toward the crown (bare-vs-finished.png left).

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Not applicable: CAD-only, with no factory stock.

checklist.item: A silhouette distinct from the other Vepres rings
checklist.reason: An open crossed twin-cane with a lateral spray and a raised oval hip. No other Vepres ring is like it.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: The large form (hip and spray) and the small forms (28 prickles) are there, but the medium layer is still weak. The 7 nodes show as small knobs, there is no bark, and long runs of plain wire remain at the shoulders and palm (hero.png lower-left and right, reverse.png). The palm prickles still stand in an even same-facing row (hero.png bottom, 7 or 8 in a row). The ornamented share of the visible surface is well under Caiman's.

punch_list.priority: P0 (only if Logan reopens the ring)
punch_list.zone: All 10 leaflets, Rose leaf 1 and 2, crown theta about 55-125
punch_list.change: Rebuild the leaflets as modelled blades, not inflated pillows. Keep 0.8 mm on a 1.0 mm-wide midrib band, give a nearly flat upper face (0.2 mm sag) and bevel the margin at 30-40 degrees. Cut 7-9 forward-hooked teeth per side, 0.2-0.25 mm, from a smooth outline sampled at 0.05 mm or finer, and sink a midvein 0.15 mm deep. Make leaf 2 a 0.85x copy with one pair folded 20 degrees.
punch_list.acceptance: In leaf-close.png every margin is a continuous serration with no stepped walls. In face-300 the spray reads as rose, not laurel, and the two leaves visibly differ.

punch_list.zone: Hip stone mesh, bezel and receptacle, crown theta 90
punch_list.change: Re-tessellate the cabochon dome (at least 128 around, 48 up, no apex fan). Replace the collar with a flared receptacle cup: a 0.6 mm fillet, a 10-15 degree flare, no flat land, tapering into the stalk over 2 mm. Lay the upright sepal down so that no single sepal stands proud over the girdle like a prong.
punch_list.acceptance: In stones.png and face.png the dome shows one smooth highlight with no bands and no star. No vertical wall or flat land is visible. No gold element reads as a claw.

punch_list.zone: Both canes, shoulders theta 15-65 and 115-165, palm theta 200-340
punch_list.change: Swell the canes from 1.4 mm at the palm to 1.8 mm at the crown. Add 0.08-0.1 mm bark fissures on the side faces and an eighth node. Re-space the palm prickles irregularly (0.6-1.6x the mean) and alternate their direction.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero.png no run of 4 or more prickles is evenly spaced and same-facing. Cane highlights break over bark, and every 45-degree sector carries a node or at least 2 prickles.
